configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as shown in the in-game server browser and on Game-Monitor

configurationFields.label: Owner Email Address
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of contact email addresses for the server owner(s). Only used by MTA administrators. Can affect visibility in the master server list if missing or incorrect

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for players to connect to the server. Default = no password

configurationFields.label: Enable Game-Monitor Reporting
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will report to the Game-Monitor master servers, allowing visibility in the in-game server browser

configurationFields.label: Disable LAN Broadcasting
configurationFields.description: If set, LAN broadcasting will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Load Modules
configurationFields.description: Specify the modules to load with the server in the <module> setting in mtaserver.conf. One module per line

configurationFields.label: Load Resources
configurationFields.description: Specify the resources to load with the server in the <resource> setting in mtaserver.conf. One resource per line

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Enable HTTP Server
configurationFields.description: If set, the built-in [HTTP server](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Server_Manual#Using_the_web_interface) will be enabled. Note that only [administrators](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Server_Manual#Adding_administrators) can access the HTTP server

configurationFields.label: HTTP Download URL
configurationFields.description: If set, specifies an [external URL](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Server_Manual#Configuring_an_external_web_server) from which clients will download needed resources in-game. Otherwise they will download them directly from the server

configurationFields.label: HTTP Max Connections Per Client
configurationFields.description: Limits the number of HTTP connections each client can make. Relevant when using an external HTTP server

configurationFields.label: HTTP DoS Threshold
configurationFields.description: Limits the number of HTTP connections that an IP can initiate over a short period of time

configurationFields.label: HTTP DoS Exclude
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses that are to be excluded from the HTTP DoS Threshold limits

configurationFields.label: Allow GTA3 IMG Mods
configurationFields.description: If set, locally customized gta3.img player skins can be used. Not recommended for competitive servers

configurationFields.label: Allowed GTA:SA Client Files
configurationFields.description: By default, the server will block the use of customized [GTA:SA data files](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Anti-cheat_guide#.3Cclient_file_name.3D.22data.2Fcarmods.dat.22_verify.3D.220.22.2F.3E). To allow specific client files, add one or more 'client_file' settings in mtaserver.conf

configurationFields.label: Disable Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of disabled anti-cheats. For example, to disable anti-cheat #2 and #3, use: 2,3. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Anti-cheat_guide#.3Cdisableac.3E.3C.2Fdisableac.3E)

configurationFields.label: Enable Special Detections
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of enabled special detections (a type of anti-cheat for usually harmless game modifications). For example, to disable special detections #31 and #32, use: 31,32. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Anti-cheat_guide#.3Cenablesd.3E.3C.2Fenablesd.3E)

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum client version. Clients with a lower version will not be allowed to connect. Empty = disabled

configurationFields.label: Auto Update Minimum Client Version
configurationFields.description: Sets whether and how the minimum client version setting is automatically updated. 'Instant' is only recommended for competitive servers

configurationFields.label: Recommended Client Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the recommended client version. Clients with a lower version will be prompted to update. Empty = disabled

configurationFields.label: Server ID File
configurationFields.description: Sets the location and file name of the server's unique private key. Used to prevent private files saved on the client from being read by other servers. [More information](http://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Filepath)

configurationFields.label: Bandwidth Reduction Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's bandwidth reduction mode

configurationFields.label: Thread Network Sync
configurationFields.description: If set, the network synchronization will be run on another thread

configurationFields.label: Backup Path
configurationFields.description: Sets the path to use for a basic backup of some server files. Basic backups are only made during server startup

configurationFields.label: Backup Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the period between each basic backup. Backups are only made during server startup, so the actual interval may be much longer. 0 = backups disabled

configurationFields.label: Backup Copies
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of backup copies to keep. 0 = backups disabled

configurationFields.label: Script Debug Log Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the level of the debugscript log file

configurationFields.label: HTML Debug Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the level of the HTML debug

configurationFields.label: Filter Duplicate Log Lines
configurationFields.description: If set, duplicate log lines will be filtered

configurationFields.label: Compact Internal Databases
configurationFields.description: Sets if and when the internal sqlite databases should be defragmented

options.1: On server start only after basic backup (default)

configurationFields.label: Enable Crash Dump Upload
configurationFields.description: Sets whether server crash dump files should be sent to MTA HQ

configurationFields.label: Enable Fakelag and Sfakelag Commands
configurationFields.description: If set, the [fakelag and sfakelag commands](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Command_fakelag) will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Auth Serial Groups
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of ACL groups that are protected by serial authorization. Login attempts to a protected account from a second serial are blocked until the serial is manually authorized via the authserial command. [More information](https://mtasa.com/authserial)

configurationFields.label: Enable Auth Serial On HTTP
configurationFields.description: Specifies if the authorized serial login checks should also apply to the HTTP interface. Protected account login attempts to the HTTP interface will only succeed if the IP address matches one recently used by the account holder in-game. [More information](https://mtasa.com/authserialhttp)

configurationFields.label: Auth Serial On HTTP IP Exceptions
configurationFields.description: Specifies which IP addresses should always pass Auth Serial On HTTP checks

configurationFields.label: Enable Database Credentials Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, extra security measures will be applied to resources which use dbConnect with MySQL

configurationFields.label: Player Triggered Event Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval for counting max triggered events (via triggerServerEvent). Exceeding this will call onPlayerTriggerEventThreshold

configurationFields.label: Maximum Player Triggered Events Per Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum triggered amount of events (via triggerServerEvent) within the specified interval. Exceeding this will call onPlayerTriggerEventThreshold

configurationFields.label: Player Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between player sync packets. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sync_interval_settings)

configurationFields.label: Lightweight Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Determines the time between lightweight (player) sync packets. Used when players are far apart. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sync_interval_settings)

configurationFields.label: Camera Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between camera sync packets. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sync_interval_settings)

configurationFields.label: Ped Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between ped sync packets when the ped is near the player. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sync_interval_settings)

configurationFields.label: Ped Far Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between ped sync packets when the ped is far away from the player. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sync_interval_settings)

configurationFields.label: Unoccupied Vehicle Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between unoccupied vehicle sync packets. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sync_interval_settings)

configurationFields.label: Keysync Mouse Rotation Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum time between key sync packets due to mouse movement. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sync_interval_settings)

configurationFields.label: Keysync Analog Movement Sync Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum time between key sync packets due to joystick movement. [More information](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sync_interval_settings)

configurationFields.label: Enable Bullet Sync
configurationFields.description: If set, the reliability of shots will be improved when using certain weapons, but will use more bandwidth. Bullet sync will be active regardless of this setting when certain glitches are enabled

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Contact Sync Radius
configurationFields.description: Sets the radius in which any contact with a vehicle will turn the player into its syncer. 0 = vehicles will not pick a new syncer based on which player is touching the vehicle

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Extrapolation Percent
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of extrapolation that clients will apply to remote vehicles (experimental). Can reduce some latency induced location disparency by predicting where the remote vehicles will probably be, but an incorrect prediction may have a negative effect

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Extrapolation Ping Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets a limit on how much time the vehicle extrapolation will attempt to compensate for. Only relevant if Vehicle Extrapolation Percent > 0

configurationFields.label: Enable Latency Reduction
configurationFields.description: If set, reduces the delay of player actions appearing on remote clients by 2 frames (approx 50ms). Experimental

configurationFields.label: Frame Rate Limit
configurationFields.description: Specifies the frame rate limit that will be applied to connecting clients. Range = 25 to 32767. 0 = uncapped

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, player voice chat will be enabled in-game

configurationFields.label: Voice Sample Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the sample rate for voice chat. Voice Chat must be enabled for this to be effective. Higher settings use more bandwidth and increase the sampling quality of voice chat

configurationFields.label: Voice Quality
configurationFields.description: Sets the voice quality for voice chat. Voice Chat must be enabled for this to be effective. Higher settings use more bandwidth and increase the overall quality of voice chat

configurationFields.label: Voice Bitrate
configurationFields.description: The voice bitrate can be set by configuring the <voice_bitrate> setting in mtaserver.conf. This will override the previous two settings. If not set, MTA handles this automatically. Use with care

deploymentSteps.name: 7-Zip Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'mtasa/7-Zip'; if (Test-Path '7z.exe') { exit 0 } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-x64.exe' -OutFile '7z-installer.exe' }; if ($?) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7zr.exe' -OutFile '7zr.exe' }; if ($?) { & ./7zr.exe x -y -aoa 7z-installer.exe *> $null 2>&1; Remove-Item -Path '7z-installer.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"

deploymentSteps.name: Server Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'mtasa'; & 7-Zip\7z.exe x -y -aoa setup\mtasa.exe -osetup server\* | Out-Null; @('acl.xml', 'banlist.xml', 'mtaserver.conf', 'vehiclecolors.conf') | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path \"server/mods/deathmatch/$_\") { Remove-Item -Path \"setup/server/mods/deathmatch/$_\" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null } }; Copy-Item -Path 'setup/server/*' -Destination 'server' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'setup' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"
